newsitem.title: USA: Ross Technology names Francis Webster CFO.
newsitem.headline: Ross Technology names Francis Webster CFO.

text.p: Ross Technology, Inc said Thursday it had appointed Francis "Kit" Webster as chief financial officer of the company, a supplier of microprocessors.
Webster most recently was president of Nirvana Systems, Inc, a PC-based securities analysis software developer in Austin, Ross Technology said.
The company said Webster earlier was president and chief operating officer of U.S. Medical Products, Inc, an Austin-based manufacturer and distributor of orthopedic implants.
